title: docs(adr-0114): repoint the consumer line at @objectstack/core for the moved import files
body:
Fixes #21107
Clause-②: no

## What changed

One line in `docs/adr/0114-field-level-error-code-catalog.md`, the `**Consumers**:` line (`:6`):

- before: `@objectstack/rest` (`import-coerce.ts`, `import-runner.ts`, `zodIssuesToFields`)
- after: `@objectstack/core` (`utils/import-coerce.ts`, `utils/import-runner.ts`), `@objectstack/rest` (`zodIssuesToFields`)

Nothing else in the file changes. File line count: 108 before, 108 after (diff +1 / -1, one file).

## Why

PR #21084 (card #20919, merged as `8368f1c0`) moved `import-coerce.ts` and `import-runner.ts` from `packages/rest/src/` to `packages/core/src/utils/`. The ADR's consumer line still listed both under `@objectstack/rest`. The line is prose, so neither `check-adr-symbol-anchors` nor `check-adr-links` reads it, and no gate caught the stale path.

## Premise check (on `origin/main` at `4e6dc233`)

- `packages/core/src/utils/import-coerce.ts` and `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts` exist. `packages/rest/src/` holds neither (`ls` answers "No such file or directory" for both).
- `zodIssuesToFields` is defined in `@objectstack/spec` (`api/zod-issues-to-fields.ts:251`, exported from `api/index.ts:46`). `@objectstack/rest` imports and re-exports it (`rest-server.ts:415`-`416`) and calls it at eight sites, so it stays listed under `@objectstack/rest` as a consumer.
- The new entry follows the spelling of the line's other entries: the package name, then paths relative to that package's `src/`, as in `@objectstack/objectql` (`validation/record-validator.ts`).
- The catalog table rows at `:29`-`:30` cite the bare file names `import-coerce.ts` / `import-runner.ts`. They are still true after the move and are not touched.

## Acceptance notes

- The move was not byte-for-byte. Across `8368f1c0` the bodies are unchanged and only the import specifiers were rewritten (`import-coerce.ts` +4 / -5, `import-runner.ts` +3 / -4). That does not affect this line.
- `zodIssuesToFields` is defined in `@objectstack/spec` (`api/zod-issues-to-fields.ts`), and the line's `@objectstack/spec` entry does not name that file. The `@objectstack/rest` entry is still true. Not changed here, because it is outside this card.
- ADR-0104 (`:41`) and ADR-0112 (`:77`) also name `packages/rest/src/import-coerce.ts`, but only in their `## Context` sections. Those describe the tree as it was when each ADR was written, so the citation is accurate for its date. Not touched.
- The card lists comment-only citations of the old paths in `objectql`, `driver-turso`, `metadata-protocol`, `plugin-security`, `spec` and three gate-script headers. They stay out of this governed one-line PR. Triage comment 5927253866 says each one is updated by the next PR that touches its file.
- `docs/**` publishes nothing, so this PR takes `skip-changeset`.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么

ADR-0114 文件头「Consumers」这一行:`import-coerce.ts`、`import-runner.ts` 这两个文件原来记在 `@objectstack/rest` 名下,现在改记到 `@objectstack/core` 的 `utils/` 目录下。`zodIssuesToFields` 仍记在 `@objectstack/rest` 名下。只改这一行,文件行数不变。

### 为什么改

这两个文件已在 PR #21084 中从 rest 包搬到 core 包,但 ADR 里写的位置还是旧的。按 ADR 找代码的人(包括 AI)会去 rest 包找,而那里已经没有这两个文件。
